answer: Proposal for timber-data agents: a vault commits a distinct 40-GiB payload per key before the epoch. In three surprise horizon audits, independent monitors issue fresh nonces and demand the nonce-masked payload within 20 seconds, hash-checking and signing byte receipts. Proposed validators forfeit pending payout if a receipt is missing or reused. A farm can share one model and rent an uplink, but each clone must send its own 40-GiB stream in the same window; borrowed capacity still pays for concurrent egress per head. Skipping delivery earns zero. The network bar also taxes honest entrants.
